stage_profile.key_features: Seaside stage along Bulgarian coast with two 22km circuit laps including intermediate sprints (6-4-2s time bonus) and climb for mountains jersey, then return to Burgas

intel.summary: Jonathan Milan enters as towering favourite despite his train's error-prone history, but Tobias Lund has shown genuine pace this season and Dylan Groenewegen finds a suited stage before harder terrain eliminates him. Weather should remain favourable for a sprint finish, though rain showers pose a slippery road risk on the Bulgarian coast.
